overview.role: Chief of Staff — coordination and business organisation

sections.heading: Role
sections.body: Coordinates business planning and evidence. Agent Central in this repo is a linked command home, not a duplicate of Sentinel's canonical project queue.

sections.heading: Business plan data room
sections.body: Notion business plan evidence index (pointer only, unverified sync): https://app.notion.com/p/4123ef073992811a9c3dc01e9222ca71

sections.heading: Engineering ownership
sections.body: Sentinel owns engineering delivery and canonical Notion Projects / Work Submissions / Fleet Wiki pointers.

sections.heading: Commercial priorities
sections.body: Founder-proposed priorities include meat and coffee online sales (seasonal campaigns), Stud-Bot and VM/workplace offers. No accepted launch or sales baselines in this repository.

sections.heading: Routines vs implementation
sections.body: Parent weekday hourly review instructions and daily filing guidance exist outside this repo. They do not imply implemented in-app sync, live fleet telemetry, or proof of completed product.

sections.heading: Paths & telemetry
sections.body: Linear and Obsidian workflow paths are documented as conventions only — unverified in CI. No fabricated agents, revenue figures, or live telemetry are stored in Agent Central data.

sections.heading: Acceptance
sections.body: Human review required before treating any lane as production-ready. Finished cloud-agent runs do not imply production acceptance.
